outcomes.name: Understanding of the case for change has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The case for change is consistently understood everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that understanding of the case for change varies across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are.
Identify why the case for change hasn't landed consistently in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish the case for change.
Confirm the case for change is being consistently referenced by leaders across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor leadership messaging to ensure the case for change stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey staff in underperforming teams/sites to understand why the case for change hasn't taken hold.
Develop targeted messaging to address the specific gaps in understanding identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted case-for-change reinforcement sessions in teams/sites where understanding is weakest.
Confirm understanding of the case for change has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks so gaps in understanding of the case for change are caught early in future.
